messages:
priyanka_pm: Quick ask — need a small deliverable set for the product launch next Tues. Focus: benchmark snapshot tiles, one webinar hero slide, and an inbound lead routing diagram. TL;DR attached brief here: https://figma.com/file/abc123/launch-kit :pushpin:

sam_design: Got it. Can you confirm sizes and brand constraints? Do we need motion? :slightly_smiling_face:

priyanka_pm: Sizes: hero 1200x628 (social), webinar slide 1920x1080, benchmark tiles 600x400 (3 variants), routing diagram 1000x800 SVG. Keep brand palette + secondary palette for contrast. No heavy motion — maybe 1 subtle micro-animation for hero GIF only.

sam_design: Copy for tiles?

nora_content: Short lines for tiles (3):
- "Lowest per-token cost at scale"
- "Predictable latency across deployments"
- "Turnkey routing and fallbacks"

priyanka_pm: Also need 2 messaging variants (technical + customer outcomes) for A/B testing in comms.

leo_growth: For inbound routing diagram, we should show: hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback, with lead scoring step and webhook to CRM. Use simplified icons.

matt_devex: FYI — add SDK icon and latency timeline for slide. We'll provide a small CSV of metrics.

sam_design: Cool. I'll draft wireframes today. Estimated ETA: initial comps by Thu EOD, final assets Mon morning. Any brand compliance checks needed beyond usual?

priyanka_pm: Yes — legal wants the "Redwood Inference" lockup present only on the slide footer, not on tiles. Also provide an accessibility contrast check report.

sam_design: Noted. I'll include an accessibility note and contrast hex codes. Figured outline for deliverables:
```
- hero_gif_v1.mp4 (1200x628)
- webinar_slide_v1.pptx (1920x1080)
- tiles_3variants.zip (600x400 each + source .fig)
- routing_diagram.svg (1000x800)
- accessibility_report.txt
```

nora_content: I'll prep alt text, short headlines, and 2 longer descriptions for the webinar registration page.

priyanka_pm: Also coordinate with sales for the lead routing labels — cc @leo_growth

leo_growth: Will turn labels into actionable fields for HubSpot. I can mock CSV mapping after final SVG.

design-bot: New Figma file created by sam_design: https://figma.com/file/def456/launch-kit-v2

sam_design: Quick Q — preferred type scale? Use h1 48/36/24 for slide headings and h3 20 for tile headings?

priyanka_pm: That works. Keep copy tight. Also add one slide version that omits technical metrics for C-suite.

matt_devex: I'll drop the latency CSV in #eng-metrics tomorrow AM.

sam_design: Thanks all — will post first comps in this thread when ready. :rocket:

priyanka_pm: Thanks! If anything blocks, ping me.
